C1 N: the tokensWithdrawn flag is introduced by the fix and does not exist in the vulnerable code; only the contract's capital balance participates.
C3 N: signature-scope defect (one renegotiation signature authorizes two operations); no feasible operation leaves related persistent state partially updated.
C5 N: a single stale gating counter read before its own update explains the over-purchase; the second counter is incidental, no cross-entity invariant is essential.
C3 N: no operation leaves related persistent state partially updated; the defect is a flash-loan-manipulable live price plus the absence of a cooldown on the defaultIncentive payout.

C3 U: the card states only that a pool amount is 'incorrectly increased' when positions are reduced; with no source excerpt it does not establish which entities are written and which are left inconsistent.
C1 N: the user-supplied message is dropped when the cross-chain message is emitted; a single propagated value is at fault, no second persistent entity is left inconsistent.
C3 N: no writer desynchronizes anything; liquidation() and rigidRedemption() simply read different subsets of the same debt state when computing collateralRatio.

C3 N: the double counting happens inside oracleExit()'s balance computation; no partial write leaves a related entity inconsistent.
C4 N: the zero amounts handed to transferFees() come from locals computed after the call, not from a persistent read; no stale or omitted persistent member is read before reconciliation.
C1 N: the excerpts show no fee-withdrawal-status variable in Erc20Quest/Quest; the fix introduces that state, so only the reward token balance participates.

C1 N: the hasVoted mapping is added by the fix and does not exist in the vulnerable code; only the veto vote tally participates.
C2 N: endTime is clobbered alongside uri/soulBounded/royalty by one settings update, but no semantic relationship between endTime and those fields is shown; they are incidental to each other.
C3 N: the defect is an inclusive/exclusive boundary that makes two mutually exclusive predicates over one timestamp both true; no writer leaves related entities partially updated.
C1 N: the _shortfall accumulator is introduced by the fix; no pre-existing second persistent entity is left un-updated by the auction.
C1 N: only the leftover token balance participates; no persistent entity records a claim on it that could be left inconsistent.
